prompt:
Use the uploaded character image and the approved contact sheet as references.

Create a production-ready transparent PNG sprite atlas for a PixiJS v8 game UI.

Character:
Original BATTLE exploit runner, "Plague Nurgling".

Keep the same broad identity:
- olive-green pudgy round creature with warts and spots
- two curved light-brown horns on the head
- small yellow eyes and wide toothy grin
- stubby arms and legs, side profile facing right
- lime-green bubbles, slime, and plague energy effects

Do not include exact franchise insignia, logos, faction marks, proprietary armor symbols, or copied commercial sprite details.

Runtime atlas requirements:
- transparent background
- no labels
- no text
- no side panel
- no grid lines
- no decorative background
- frames only
- strict frame grid
- every frame exactly 64x64 pixels
- character always faces right
- feet aligned to the same baseline in every frame
- consistent character scale across all frames
- nearest-neighbor pixel art style
- crisp hard pixel edges
- no anti-aliased painterly edges
- no motion blur outside pixel-art style
- no shadows outside the frame unless part of the sprite
- leave unused frame cells transparent

Grid layout:
8 columns.
14 rows.
Rows with fewer than 8 frames should leave remaining cells transparent.

Rows:
Row 0: idle - 4 frames, then 4 transparent empty cells
Row 1: walk - 6 frames, then 2 transparent empty cells
Row 2: run - 8 frames
Row 3: research - 6 frames, then 2 transparent empty cells
Row 4: payload - 6 frames, then 2 transparent empty cells
Row 5: mutate - 6 frames, then 2 transparent empty cells
Row 6: handoff - 6 frames, then 2 transparent empty cells
Row 7: spawn - 8 frames
Row 8: blocked - 6 frames, then 2 transparent empty cells
Row 9: hit - 3 frames, then 5 transparent empty cells
Row 10: killed - 8 frames
Row 11: victory - 8 frames
Row 12: promoted - 8 frames
Row 13: fastest_crash - 8 frames

Output only the transparent sprite atlas image. Do not draw metadata, labels, captions, or JSON inside the image.
